integrity: The proof reduces the chain-extension optimization to a weighted two-dimensional one-center problem, solves that problem exactly using the isometry between two-dimensional l1 and linfinity, and then solves the cointegral-basis optimization over the integral homology lattice. The primary source was inspected at the definition and relevant examples, and exact source/alias/implication searches were compared against the claim.
scientific_limitations: The theorem is restricted to finite simplicial three-path theta graphs in degree one. It does not compute algebraic gnarledness for arbitrary rank-two graphs, arbitrary series-parallel graphs, or higher degrees. The finite verifier checks bounded samples only and is not used to justify the universal quantifiers.
title: Exact algebraic gnarledness of three-path theta graphs
